```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(glue)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(forcats)
library(UpSetR)
```

read in data
```{r}
setwd(dirname(getwd()))
source("00-paths.R")

corr <- read.csv(file.path(paths$derived, "CoRR4684_formatted.csv")) %>%
  select(vitalstatus, ppi, statin, immunotherapy, iostart, ppi_start, h2b_iostart, steroid_iostart, 
         abx_iostart, nsaid_iostart, cancer.name, PPI.days.to.iostart, H2B.days.to.iostart, days)
lung <- read.csv(file.path(paths$derived, "P188_formatted.csv")) %>%
  select(vitalstatus, ppi, statin, immunotherapy, iostart, ppi_start, h2b_iostart, steroid_iostart, 
         abx_iostart, nsaid_iostart, cancer.name, PPI.days.to.iostart, H2B.days.to.iostart, days)

db <- corr %>% rbind(lung)
```

```{r}
check.window <- function(vect, per){
  wind <- per[1]:per[2]
  wind <- glue_collapse(as.character(wind), sep = ",|,")
  wind <- paste(",", wind, ",", sep = "")
  ifelse(grepl(pattern = wind, x = vect), 1, 0)
}
db <- db %>%
  mutate(PPI.to.iostart = paste(",", PPI.days.to.iostart, ",", sep = ""),
         ppi_start = check.window(PPI.days.to.iostart, c(-28,28)))
```


```{r define interesting columns}
meds_iostart <- c("h2b_iostart", "nsaid_iostart", "ppi", "statin", "steroid_iostart", "abx_iostart")
allcancers <- c('Other', 'Melanoma', 'Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer', 'Head and Neck Carcinoma', 'Renal Cell Carcinoma', 'Sarcoma', 'Bladder Cancer')
```

# A+B) Survival curves of each medication at iostart

```{r create survival plots}
forms <- list()
for(var in meds_iostart){
  forms[[var]] <- as.formula(paste("Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ ", var, sep = ""))
}
sfits <- surv_fit(formula = forms, data = db)
names(sfits) <- meds_iostart
almeds.plots <- ggsurvplot(sfits, pval = TRUE, conf.int = FALSE, 
                           risk.table = TRUE,title = "", legend.title = "", 
                           legend.labs = list(c("Not prescribed", "Prescribed H2B's")), 
                           ylab = "", xlab = "Days", palette = c("slateblue2", "lightsalmon2"), 
                           fontsize = 6, font.legend = list(size = 12))
```

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
almeds.plots[["ppi"]]
almeds.plots[["h2b_iostart"]]
```
